# Generated by tools/m10_history.py --write; first-century disasters.
# A disaster is rooted in its named recipient country and ends with its window.

# Year of the Four Emperors; ANTIQVITAS master plan §9
antq_m10_year_four_emperors = {
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_unique
	can_start = {
		tag = XAA
		current_date >= 68.1.1
		current_date < 70.1.1
		has_any_active_disaster = no
	}
	can_end = {
		OR = {
			current_date >= 70.1.1
			var:antq_m10_year_four_emperors_resolution_progress >= 100
		}
	}
	modifier = {
		global_manpower_modifier = -0.04
		global_monthly_food_modifier = -0.025
		tax_income_efficiency = tiny_tax_income_efficiency_penalty
	}
	on_start = {
		set_variable = { name = antq_m10_year_four_emperors_resolution_progress value = 0 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = antq_m10.1021
	}
	on_monthly = {
		if = {
			limit = { stability >= 20 at_war = no }
			change_variable = { name = antq_m10_year_four_emperors_resolution_progress add = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { stability >= 0 at_war = yes }
			change_variable = { name = antq_m10_year_four_emperors_resolution_progress add = 1.5 }
		}
		else = {
			change_variable = { name = antq_m10_year_four_emperors_resolution_progress add = 0.5 }
		}
		random_list = {
			1 = {
				add_manpower = { value = monthly_manpower multiply = -0.5 }
				add_gold = { value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax multiply = -0.25 }
				capital = { province = { change_province_food_percentage = -0.01 } }
			}
			23 = {}
		}
	}
	on_end = {
		if = { limit = { has_variable = antq_m10_year_four_emperors_resolution_progress } remove_variable = antq_m10_year_four_emperors_resolution_progress }
		add_stability = stability_weak_bonus
	}
}
